Context: 2. Entitlement of staff car

## 2. Entitlement of staff car  
- (a)
- Officers of the rank of Joint Secretary to Government of India and above;
- Heads of Departments, drawing pay in the Senior Administrative
- (b) Grade and above.  
Staff car facility will be withdrawn if they opt for drawing admissible - Para. 4 of OM, dated 1-9-2022.  
Transport Allowance.
